violations.text: The walk-in cooler door was observed with a gap at the bottom. Per PIC, the walk-in cooler door threshold will be replaced to make the door tight fitting. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and refrigeration units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
Establishment is lacking a dumpster. PIC is to send proof of dumpster to inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

The following was observed in poor repair. -Grout by the walk-in cooler -Floor tiles cracked in the bar area -Parts of the FRP walls in the kitchen observed with small holes The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2026
